before.title: Arrive in Tangier Airport/Ferry – Transfer to Hotel/Riad
body: Transport, Breakfast

You’ll tart Tangier Morocco tours via Sahara desert, by picking you up from tangier airport or Ferry you are and transfer you to your hotel/riad to relax and store your luggage. Then in the afternoon you can take a tour around tangier to discover Spartel cape and the hercules caves by your private transport. From the Greek hero Hercules caves you’ll have an exceptional view of the strait -of- Gibraltar and the Atlantic- Ocean. Then you can visit the Kasbah a magnificent Minaret,” . At the end of your tour, your driver will take you back to your Hotel/riad for (overnight stay) .

before.title: Tangier – Chefchaouen Blue City
body: Transport (2hrs), Breakfast

This morning after breakfast at your hotel/riad your driver will pick you up to start your Morocco adventure desert tours, towards Chefchaouen, the blue and white City Established in 1471 by Moulay Ali Ben Moussa Ben Rached El Alamiand Up on arrival to Chefchaouen, we’ll drop you off to your hotel/riad to relax and store your luggage. After that you can take a tour around Chefchaouen to discover the best monuments such as kasbah built back to 18th century, central mosque, local market (souk) full of tourists souvenirs,cafes with Moroccan original style menus. Chefchaouen Medina is small and easy to explore by yourself.

before.title: Chefchaouen – Volubilis – Meknes – Fez
body: Transport (4hrs), Breakfast

Leave Chefchaouen and head south to Volubilis, the most important and extensive remains of a Roman city in Morocco, and one of the most distant of the Empire’s domain, thanks to the powerful Berber tribes who showed themselves to be more than a match for the conquering legionnaires. Once one of the most important regions producing grain to feed the voracious Roman appetite, and wild animals to keep the crowds entertained as they tried to devour gladiators in the arena, this prosperous provincial city was home to some 200,000 residents at the height of its glory, with sumptuous mosaics still to be seen in some of the most luxurious homes.

You move on to Moulay Idriss, which, from a distance, looks like a sitting camel. The oldest town in Morocco, it was founded by Moulay Idriss I in 789, having fled Mecca because of religious and tribal conflicts. It was here that the Idrisid dynasty was founded, and the town has the only round minaret in Morocco. You end today in one of Morocco’s four imperial cities, Fez.

before.title: Fez Guided Tour
body: Transport, Breakfast

Your own private Fez guide tour, Your tour lasts from 9:30am until 4:30pm with a break for lunch. Before you head out in the morning, you can discuss with your guide which sights you’d like to see most. If you have never been to Fez before you might like to read our travel guide to Fes, which will not only give you a fascinating insight into this equally fascinating city, but will also help you decide which sites you would like to experience with the help of your guide. It really will be worth your while to put yourself in his hands and allow him to show you the mysteries and secrets of the nine thousand streets and alleyways that make up this amazing historic city – but don’t worry, you won’t be expected to walk all of them!

before.title: Fez – Ifrane – Ziz Valley – Erfoud – Merzouga
body: Transport, Breakfast , Dinner

Today you will head towards Midelt passing through Ifrane. Located in the mountains of the Middle Atlas, this is an oasis of coolness and vegetation. With its lakes and fountains of alpine characteristics known throughout the world as the “Moroccan Switzerland”, Above all for the European style houses with sloping roofs which have nothing to do with the traditional architecture of Morocco. Then, we will drive through “Azrou ” an important Berber village located in the interior of the Middle Atlas and surrounded by hills. The main interest of this small town is its surrounding cedar forest and where you can see the famous Big Gouraud Cedar the largest millennial of the region, you’ll heading though the lash palm groves Ziz valley and the date palm city Erfoud. In the first place, one of the charms of this town is its tranquility. We will also have the possibility to visit the factory of fossils. Then, we will continue to the Sahara desert Merzouga , overnight at the Hotel/Riad

before.title: Merzouga – Erg Chebbi Sand dunes , night under the stars
body: Transport, Breakfast, Dinner

Today you are going to experience one of the most memorable moments of your Morocco adventure as you make your way into the dunes of Morocco’s Erg Chebbi region of the Sahara Desert. You’ll have this morning to relax and/or explore Merzouga ; Khamlia and desert lake, also you can have a desert pizza at one of the best traditional desert restaurant before preparing for a memorable night under the stars. A hour’s camel ride weaving along the tops of the sand dunes brings you to your camp, with its Bedouin style tents and thick Moroccan carpets to keep the sand from between your toes. A tasty meal is your dinner, eaten by candlelight. You’ll probably choose to drift off to sleep while watching the twinkling stars during the Summer time.

before.title: Sahara Desert – Tinjdad – Todra Gorge – Dades Gorge
body: Transport, Breakfast , Dinner

This morning, your camel man will wake you up to see another beautiful sunrise which will maybe be the best one you see in your life. After the sunrise, you will mount your camel going back to your hotel before you leave to Rissani, Tinghir, and the amazing Todra Gorges (the highest and narrowest Gorges in Morocco). There, we will stop for lunch in Tinjdad ksar Elkhorbat (optional). Explore the Dades Valley in this unique Tangier Morocco tours via Sahara desert, where you will see the magical sand castles and the amazing rock formations known as monkey toes. Overnight accommodation will be in a Hotel/Riad/Kasbah in Dades valley .

before.title: Dades Gorge – Ouarzazate – Ait Ben Haddou
body: Transport, Breakfast , Dinner

After your breakfast in your hotel, you will travel through the Dades Valley towards Kalaa M’gouna and Ouarzazate. Then you will travel toward Ouarzazate via Skoura the Valley of 1,000 Kasbahs From there you will continue passing several Kasbahs toward El Kalaa Mgouna which is known for vast fields of pink roses that are used in perfume. Many small shops selling rose products such as rose water and rose-scented soap. Then, you will continue to Ouarzazate known as the Hollywood of Morocco, and visit the Film studios and then to Ait ben Haddou , overnight at the hotel/Kasbah .

before.title: Ait Ben Haddou – Telouet – Marrakech
body: Transport, Breakfast

Your most vivid memory from today will be of your visit to Ait Ben Haddou, a UNESCO world heritage site, which, as well as being the best extant example in the area of a walled town protected by Kasbahs, the homes of the wealthy and powerful, has been the backdrop to many Hollywood blockbusters and major historical television programs, including Gladiator and Lawrence of Arabia. If you are a fan of A Game of Thrones you will recognize Ait Ben Haddou from the final scene of series three. (The series has used a number of locations around Morocco.) From Ait Ben Haddou, you may wish to continue to the lesser-visited (and possibly more impressive) area of Telouet. Here, you can meander about the former palace of the Glaoui family and even enjoy lunch with a private local (once celebrity) Berber singer chanting of days gone by. The last leg of today’s journey is over the High Atlas Mountains on the impressive zig-zag of Tiz n Tichka pass, eventually to arrive in Marrakech for the overnight.

before.title: Marrakech Guided Tour
body: Transport, Breakfast

Exploring Marrakech with an official guide, the tour lasts from 9:30am till 5pm, The First thing you will see is the historic Koutoubia Mosque from 12century, known for its four distinct faces. Moreover, the Saadian tombs and Bahia palace which showcases the finest examples of traditional design elements. Such as decorative tile, painted, wood, carved plaster, and calligraphy. Furthermore, you will have the chance to visit the beautiful Majorelle Gardens just outside the ancient medina. Where the famous French stylist Yves Saint Laurent is buried, trees and flowers from the 5 continents gathered together in an amazing oasis of peace it’s really worth to be seen. Then, visit the souks and end your day in Jama’a el-Fna square, which is a UNESCO world heritage site, In Jama’a el-Fna you will see snake charmers, story-tellers, henna artists and dancers. This square has been the heart of the Medina since the 12th century. A home for performers, travelers and fortune-tellers, Stop for a glass of fresh squeezed orange juice and enjoy the carnival atmosphere. body: Transport, Breakfast

You’ll start your Tangier Morocco tours via Sahara desert, by picking you up from tangier airport or Ferry you are and transfer you to your hotel/riad to relax and store your luggage. Then in the afternoon you can take a tour around tangier to discover Spartel cape and the hercules caves by your private transport. From the Greek hero Hercules caves you’ll have an exceptional view of the strait -of- Gibraltar and the Atlantic- Ocean. Then you can visit the Kasbah a magnificent Minaret,” . At the end of your tour, your driver will take you back to your Hotel/riad for (overnight stay) .

after.title: Tangier – Chefchaouen Blue City
body: Transport (2hrs), Breakfast

This morning after breakfast at your hotel/riad your driver will pick you up to start your Morocco adventure desert tours, towards Chefchaouen, the blue and white City Established in 1471 by Moulay Ali Ben Moussa Ben Rached El Alamiand Up on arrival to Chefchaouen, we’ll drop you off to your hotel/riad to relax and store your luggage. After that you can take a tour around Chefchaouen to discover the best monuments such as kasbah built back to 18th century, central mosque, local market (souk) full of tourists souvenirs,cafes with Moroccan original style menus. Chefchaouen Medina is small and easy to explore by yourself.

after.title: Chefchaouen – Volubilis – Meknes – Fez
body: Transport (4hrs), Breakfast

Leave Chefchaouen and head south to Volubilis, the most important and extensive remains of a Roman city in Morocco, and one of the most distant of the Empire’s domain, thanks to the powerful Berber tribes who showed themselves to be more than a match for the conquering legionnaires. Once one of the most important regions producing grain to feed the voracious Roman appetite, and wild animals to keep the crowds entertained as they tried to devour gladiators in the arena, this prosperous provincial city was home to some 200,000 residents at the height of its glory, with sumptuous mosaics still to be seen in some of the most luxurious homes.

You move on to Moulay Idriss, which, from a distance, looks like a sitting camel. The oldest town in Morocco, it was founded by Moulay Idriss I in 789, having fled Mecca because of religious and tribal conflicts. It was here that the Idrisid dynasty was founded, and the town has the only round minaret in Morocco. You end today in one of Morocco’s four imperial cities, Fez.

after.title: Fez Guided Tour
body: Transport, Breakfast

Your own private Fez guide tour, Your tour lasts from 9:30am until 4:30pm with a break for lunch. Before you head out in the morning, you can discuss with your guide which sights you’d like to see most. If you have never been to Fez before you might like to read our travel guide to Fes, which will not only give you a fascinating insight into this equally fascinating city, but will also help you decide which sites you would like to experience with the help of your guide. It really will be worth your while to put yourself in his hands and allow him to show you the mysteries and secrets of the nine thousand streets and alleyways that make up this amazing historic city – but don’t worry, you won’t be expected to walk all of them!

after.title: Fez – Ifrane – Ziz Valley – Erfoud – Merzouga
body: Transport, Breakfast , Dinner

Today you will head towards Midelt passing through Ifrane. Located in the mountains of the Middle Atlas, this is an oasis of coolness and vegetation. With its lakes and fountains of alpine characteristics known throughout the world as the “Moroccan Switzerland”, Above all for the European style houses with sloping roofs which have nothing to do with the traditional architecture of Morocco. Then, we will drive through “Azrou ” an important Berber village located in the interior of the Middle Atlas and surrounded by hills. The main interest of this small town is its surrounding cedar forest and where you can see the famous Big Gouraud Cedar the largest millennial of the region, you’ll heading though the lush palm groves Ziz valley and the date palm city Erfoud. In the first place, one of the charms of this town is its tranquility. We will also have the possibility to visit the factory of fossils. Then, we will continue to the Sahara desert Merzouga , overnight at the Hotel/Riad

after.title: Merzouga – Erg Chebbi Sand dunes , night under the stars
body: Transport, Breakfast, Dinner

Today you are going to experience one of the most memorable moments of your Morocco adventure as you make your way into the dunes of Morocco’s Erg Chebbi region of the Sahara Desert. You’ll have this morning to relax and/or explore Merzouga ; Khamlia and desert lake, also you can have a desert pizza at one of the best traditional desert restaurant before preparing for a memorable night under the stars. A hour’s camel ride weaving along the tops of the sand dunes brings you to your camp, with its Bedouin style tents and thick Moroccan carpets to keep the sand from between your toes. A tasty meal is your dinner, eaten by candlelight. You’ll probably choose to drift off to sleep while watching the twinkling stars during the Summer time.

after.title: Sahara Desert – Tinjdad – Todra Gorge – Dades Gorge
body: Transport, Breakfast , Dinner

This morning, your camel man will wake you up to see another beautiful sunrise which will maybe be the best one you see in your life. After the sunrise, you will mount your camel going back to your hotel before you leave to Rissani, Tinghir, and the amazing Todra Gorges (the highest and narrowest Gorges in Morocco). There, we will stop for lunch in Tinjdad ksar Elkhorbat (optional). Explore the Dades Valley in this unique Tangier Morocco tours via Sahara desert, where you will see the magical sand castles and the amazing rock formations known as monkey toes. Overnight accommodation will be in a Hotel/Riad/Kasbah in Dades valley .

after.title: Dades Gorge – Ouarzazate – Ait Ben Haddou
body: Transport, Breakfast , Dinner

After your breakfast in your hotel, you will travel through the Dades Valley towards Kalaa M’gouna and Ouarzazate. Then you will travel toward Ouarzazate via Skoura the Valley of 1,000 Kasbahs From there you will continue passing several Kasbahs toward El Kalaa Mgouna which is known for vast fields of pink roses that are used in perfume. Many small shops selling rose products such as rose water and rose-scented soap. Then, you will continue to Ouarzazate known as the Hollywood of Morocco, and visit the Film studios and then to Ait ben Haddou , overnight at the hotel/Kasbah .

after.title: Ait Ben Haddou – Telouet – Marrakech
body: Transport, Breakfast

Your most vivid memory from today will be of your visit to Ait Ben Haddou, a UNESCO world heritage site, which, as well as being the best extant example in the area of a walled town protected by Kasbahs, the homes of the wealthy and powerful, has been the backdrop to many Hollywood blockbusters and major historical television programs, including Gladiator and Lawrence of Arabia. If you are a fan of A Game of Thrones you will recognize Ait Ben Haddou from the final scene of series three. (The series has used a number of locations around Morocco.) From Ait Ben Haddou, you may wish to continue to the lesser-visited (and possibly more impressive) area of Telouet. Here, you can meander about the former palace of the Glaoui family and even enjoy lunch with a private local (once celebrity) Berber singer chanting of days gone by. The last leg of today’s journey is over the High Atlas Mountains on the impressive zig-zag of Tiz n Tichka pass, eventually to arrive in Marrakech for the overnight.

after.title: Marrakech Guided Tour
body: Transport, Breakfast

Exploring Marrakech with an official guide, the tour lasts from 9:30am till 5pm, The First thing you will see is the historic Koutoubia Mosque from 12century, known for its four distinct faces. Moreover, the Saadian tombs and Bahia palace which showcases the finest examples of traditional design elements. Such as decorative tile, painted, wood, carved plaster, and calligraphy. Furthermore, you will have the chance to visit the beautiful Majorelle Gardens just outside the ancient medina. Where the famous French stylist Yves Saint Laurent is buried, trees and flowers from the 5 continents gathered together in an amazing oasis of peace it’s really worth to be seen. Then, visit the souks and end your day in Jama’a el-Fna square, which is a UNESCO world heritage site, In Jama’a el-Fna you will see snake charmers, story-tellers, henna artists and dancers. This square has been the heart of the Medina since the 12th century. Welcome to Morocco!. Upon arrival, you will be collected and taken to your hotel to unwind and relax and exploring the main square Jemaa el Fnaa and the souks.

body: Transport , Breakfast

A full-day tour of Marrakech, visit the Menara, a surrounded pool by flowerbeds that function as an irrigation system for the surrounded fields. Enjoy a sunset drink overlooking the exciting Jamaa El Fna Square from a terrace of a cafe, dinner and night at hotel.

body: Transport , 7hrs , Breakfast , Dinner

Pick up you in Raid/Hotel towards Ouarzazate, through the Tizi- N-Tichka pass (2260m) in the High Atlas Mountains. You will enjoy beautiful landscapes with different colors’ and the Berber villages along the way between Atlas Mountains and Ouarzazate, the doorway to the Sahara desert. You will visit the UNESCO world heritage site Ait Benhaddou. Kasbah is one of many locations served as a natural decoration for many movies which were shot in the area such as “Lawrence of Arabia and Jesus of Nazareth” Take a walk and cross the dried river to discover Enesco Heritage Ait benhaddou and dominate the Kasbahs once you get to the top of the hill. Afterwards, you will head directly to Ouarzazate, You will Continue to Skoura palm grove, then Valley of the Roses the centre of Moroccan roses and rose products. Continue via the strange rock creation of Tamnalt Hills to Dades gorge, carved over centuries by the Dades River. Overnight right in the Dades Gorge lined by the red and mauve rock overnight in heart of dades Gorge. 7hrs of journey

before.title: Dades Gorge -Todra Gorge – Erg Chehbi.
body: Transport 5hrs , Breakfast , Dinner

Once you arrive to the hotel near by the dunes having a cup of meant tea, and then you will take a camel ride for 1h at the sunset to get to the oasis where the camp is located and see the sunset. Spend the night in nomadic tent under shooting stars. With Berber music sometimes, Have diner in the camp. 5hrs of journey

before.title: Explore Merzouga and Relaxing
body: Transport 1hr , Breakfast , Dinner

Today you’ll discovering the area, firstly visiting the Gnawa music family – originally slaves brought from Sudan, to experience their music and lifestyle. Not far away there’s also the lake of Merzouga, with its bird populations. Afterwards you’ll leave for Rissani – once called Sijilmassa and the meeting place for the salt caravans, coming from Timbuktu in Mali. Here you’ll walk through the souk, smelling the spices, vegetables and cloths all for local sale. After a pizza lunch in khamlia village, we’ll travel back to your Riad where your camel awaits you. After a glass of mint tea, and guided by an experienced camel man, after this experience you’ll go back to the hotel for relaxing and be ready for your next adventure day . 1hrs of journey

before.title: Marrakech | Ait Bougmez – Agouti
body: This morning you will be meeting with our Local guide and private tourism transport to start your journey to the Ait Bougmez happy valley in the Central High Atlas Mountains. The journey takes a total of around four hours, but we break the journey half way with a visit to Morocco’s most impressive waterfall – the Cascades d’Ouzoud. Arriving at the village of Ouzoud, set in a broad flat valley, one has little idea of what lies beyond. Passing the cluster of restaurants and souvenir shops, the ground drops away dramatically, giving way to a verdant gorge, with three beautiful cascades of white water falling into the pools below. Here you can take a walk down to the foot of the falls and choose an appropriate spot for a picnic lunch prepared by local guide and cook. After lunch we continue, through the town of Azilal and along a winding mountain road and cross Tizi Oughbar pass at 2200m) then continue zigzags down to join the valley of Ait Bougmez, Overnight in camp or Gite in agouti 1760m). body: Today, we head always the happy valley and our walk always between the gardens, then we stop in Ibakalouin village to visit the dinosaur track then continue via Rbat then continue to join a cold spring water we camp next to, altitude there 2108m) , include (B.L.D)Duration: 05H.

after.title: Marrakech – Ouzoud Waterfalls – Agouti (Aït Bougmez)
body: After meeting your local mountain guide and private driver in Marrakech, we set off towards the Central High Atlas Mountains. Along the way, we visit the spectacular Ouzoud Waterfalls, where you can enjoy a walk through the lush gorge and admire the impressive cascades. We stop for a picnic lunch before continuing through Azilal and crossing the scenic Tizi Oughbar Pass (2,200 m). We then descend into the beautiful Aït Bougmez Valley, arriving in Agouti (1,760 m), where you spend your first night in a traditional Berber guesthouse or camp.

after.title: Agouti – Aguerd N'Ouzrou – Aït Imi Spring Camp
after.accommodation: Camp at Aït Imi spring (2,083 m)
body: After breakfast, we begin our trek through the heart of the Happy Valley, walking along beautiful paths surrounded by apple orchards, walnut trees and traditional Berber villages. We pass through Aguerd N'Ouzrou, where we enjoy a relaxing lunch beneath the walnut trees, close to a natural spring and the historic village. After a leisurely break, we continue towards Aït Imi village and its refreshing natural spring at 2,083 m, where we set up camp for the night.

after.title: Aït Imi Spring – Ibakliwin – Rbat
after.accommodation: Camp at a natural spring near Rbat (2,108 m)
body: Today's walk continues through the peaceful Happy Valley, following scenic paths between cultivated fields, orchards and traditional Amazigh villages. We make a special stop at Ibakliwin village to discover its remarkable dinosaur footprints, an interesting reminder of the region's prehistoric past. We then continue towards Rbat village, enjoying the beautiful mountain scenery along the way. By the afternoon, we reach a refreshing natural spring at approximately 2,108 m, where we establish our camp and enjoy a relaxing evening surrounded by the mountains.

after.title: Rbat – Aqqa N'Ouilzouay Pass – Ifran – Aït Hkim Valley – Timite
body: After breakfast, we leave Rbat village and gradually climb towards the beautiful plateau of Aqqa N'Ouilzouay, reaching an altitude of approximately 2,473 m. From here, we enjoy magnificent views of the surrounding High Atlas Mountains before descending towards Ifran village and entering the picturesque Aït Hkim Valley. Our route passes through several traditional Berber villages, terraced fields and beautiful walnut groves. We stop beside the river for a picnic lunch before continuing along the valley towards Timite village (1,950 m), where we spend our final night in a welcoming local Berber guesthouse.

after.title: Timite – Azilal – Marrakech
body: After breakfast, we say goodbye to the beautiful Aït Bougmez Valley and begin our private transfer back to Marrakech. We follow the winding mountain road through the spectacular landscapes of the Central High Atlas, passing traditional Berber villages, agricultural terraces and impressive mountain scenery. We continue towards Azilal before travelling through the foothills of the Atlas Mountains and the surrounding countryside. Along the way, we can stop for photographs, refreshments and lunch at a local restaurant. In the afternoon, we continue towards Marrakech, arriving in the city and transferring you to your accommodation, marking the end of our wonderful five-day Happy Valley trekking adventure.
